sentences.text: Depuis sa chambre d'hôpital, Thomas regarde une barge descendre lentement le fleuve.
sentences.en: From his hospital room, Thomas watches a barge slowly going down the river.
sentences.ko: 병실에서 토마는 바지선이 천천히 강을 내려가는 걸 바라봐요.

sentences.text: En été, Chloé aime regarder les barges glisser sur le canal.
sentences.en: In summer, Chloé likes to watch the barges glide along the canal.
sentences.ko: 여름이면 클로에는 운하를 미끄러지듯 지나는 바지선을 즐겨 봐요.

sentences.text: Les internes forment une petite clique bruyante dans le couloir, remarque Thomas.
sentences.en: The interns form a noisy little clique in the corridor, Thomas notes.
sentences.ko: 인턴들이 복도에서 시끄러운 무리를 이룬다고 토마가 말해요.

sentences.text: À la rentrée, Chloé retrouve sa petite clique d'amies au café.
sentences.en: When autumn term starts, Chloé meets up with her little clique of friends at the café.
sentences.ko: 가을 새 학기가 되면 클로에는 카페에서 친한 친구 무리를 다시 만나요.

sentences.text: Avant d'entrer au bloc, Thomas doit laisser sa montre et sa bague, achetées à la même bijouterie.
sentences.en: Before going into surgery, Thomas has to leave his watch and ring, bought at the same jeweler's.
sentences.ko: 수술실에 들어가기 전 토마는 같은 보석 가게에서 산 시계와 반지를 맡겨야 해요.

sentences.text: Chaque hiver, la bijouterie du quartier décore sa vitrine, et Chloé s'arrête pour la regarder.
sentences.en: Every winter, the neighborhood jeweler's decorates its window, and Chloé stops to look.
sentences.ko: 겨울마다 동네 보석 가게가 진열창을 꾸미면 클로에는 멈춰 서서 구경해요.

sentences.text: La sœur de Thomas lui apporte des chaussons chauds pour marcher dans les couloirs.
sentences.en: Thomas's sister brings him warm slippers for walking in the corridors.
sentences.ko: 토마의 누나가 복도를 걸을 때 신을 따뜻한 실내화를 가져와요.

sentences.text: Dès les premiers froids, Chloé sort ses chaussons en laine.
sentences.en: As soon as the first cold arrives, Chloé gets out her wool slippers.
sentences.ko: 첫추위가 오자마자 클로에는 털 실내화를 꺼내요.

sentences.text: Thomas lit un article sur l'histoire de la dépénalisation de l'homosexualité dans la salle d'attente.
sentences.en: Thomas reads an article on the history of the decriminalization of homosexuality in the waiting room.
sentences.ko: 토마는 대기실에서 동성애 비범죄화의 역사에 관한 기사를 읽어요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, Chloé défile avec ses amis pour les droits liés à l'homosexualité.
sentences.en: In spring, Chloé marches with her friends for rights related to homosexuality.
sentences.ko: 봄이면 클로에는 친구들과 동성애자 권리 행진에 함께해요.

sentences.text: Un trio de clowns passe chaque mercredi dans le service, et Thomas les attend avec impatience.
sentences.en: A trio of clowns comes through the ward every Wednesday, and Thomas waits eagerly for them.
sentences.ko: 광대 세 명이 수요일마다 병동을 찾아오는데, 토마는 그들을 손꼽아 기다려요.

sentences.text: Chloé et ses deux sœurs forment un trio inséparable lors des cueillettes d'automne.
sentences.en: Chloé and her two sisters form an inseparable trio during autumn picking.
sentences.ko: 가을 열매 따기 때면 클로에와 두 자매는 떼려야 뗄 수 없는 삼총사가 돼요.

sentences.text: Thomas achète un snack au distributeur du hall en attendant ses résultats.
sentences.en: Thomas buys a snack from the lobby vending machine while waiting for his results.
sentences.ko: 토마는 결과를 기다리며 로비 자판기에서 간식을 사요.

sentences.text: En été, le snack de la plage ouvre enfin, et Chloé y achète une glace.
sentences.en: In summer, the beach snack bar finally opens, and Chloé buys an ice cream there.
sentences.ko: 여름이 되면 해변 간이식당이 드디어 문을 열고 클로에는 거기서 아이스크림을 사요.

sentences.text: Après l'opération, le médecin recommande à Thomas un repos prolongé.
sentences.en: After the operation, the doctor recommends extended rest for Thomas.
sentences.ko: 수술 뒤 의사는 토마에게 오래 쉬라고 권해요.

sentences.text: Cette année, l'été prolongé a retardé la chute des feuilles, note Chloé.
sentences.en: This year, the extended summer delayed the falling of the leaves, Chloé notes.
sentences.ko: 올해는 여름이 길어서 낙엽이 늦게 졌다고 클로에가 말해요.

sentences.text: Thomas oublie le code de verrouillage de son téléphone après l'anesthésie.
sentences.en: Thomas forgets his phone's lock code after the anesthesia.
sentences.ko: 마취에서 깬 토마는 휴대폰 잠금 비밀번호를 까먹어요.

sentences.text: Avec le gel, le verrouillage de la voiture de Chloé reste bloqué.
sentences.en: With the frost, the lock on Chloé's car stays stuck.
sentences.ko: 서리 때문에 클로에의 자동차 잠금장치가 얼어붙어요.

sentences.text: La secrétaire propose à Thomas un créneau tôt le matin pour son scanner.
sentences.en: The secretary offers Thomas an early-morning slot for his scan.
sentences.ko: 비서가 토마에게 이른 아침 시간대로 CT 촬영을 잡아 줘요.

sentences.text: Chloé profite d'un créneau ensoleillé pour étendre son linge dehors.
sentences.en: Chloé takes advantage of a sunny window to hang her washing outside.
sentences.ko: 클로에는 해가 잠깐 난 틈을 타서 빨래를 밖에 널어요.

sentences.text: Thomas regarde l'agent d'entretien faire le balayage du couloir à l'aube.
sentences.en: Thomas watches the cleaner sweep the corridor at dawn.
sentences.ko: 토마는 새벽에 청소원이 복도를 쓰는 걸 지켜봐요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, Chloé se fait faire un balayage blond chez le coiffeur.
sentences.en: In spring, Chloé gets blonde highlights at the hairdresser's.
sentences.ko: 봄이 되면 클로에는 미용실에서 금발 하이라이트를 넣어요.

sentences.text: Thomas attend avec impatience la visite hebdomadaire de ses enfants.
sentences.en: Thomas eagerly waits for his children's weekly visit.
sentences.ko: 토마는 아이들이 매주 찾아오는 날을 손꼽아 기다려요.

sentences.text: Chloé note le changement de saison dans sa chronique hebdomadaire pour le journal local.
sentences.en: Chloé notes the change of season in her weekly column for the local paper.
sentences.ko: 클로에는 지역 신문 주간 칼럼에 계절 변화를 적어요.

sentences.text: Thomas tenait une quincaillerie avant son accident, raconte-t-il à l'infirmière.
sentences.en: Thomas ran a hardware store before his accident, he tells the nurse.
sentences.ko: 토마는 사고 전에 철물점을 했다고 간호사에게 얘기해요.

sentences.text: À l'automne, Chloé achète une pelle à la quincaillerie pour ramasser les feuilles.
sentences.en: In autumn, Chloé buys a shovel at the hardware store to pick up the leaves.
sentences.ko: 가을이면 클로에는 낙엽을 치우려고 철물점에서 삽을 사요.

sentences.text: Au déjeuner, l'hôpital sert à Thomas une salade de concombre sans sauce.
sentences.en: At lunch, the hospital serves Thomas a cucumber salad without dressing.
sentences.ko: 점심에 병원은 토마에게 드레싱 없는 오이 샐러드를 줘요.

sentences.text: En plein été, Chloé ne mange presque que du concombre et des tomates.
sentences.en: In midsummer, Chloé eats almost nothing but cucumber and tomatoes.
sentences.ko: 한여름에 클로에는 거의 오이와 토마토만 먹어요.

sentences.text: Thomas ne veut pas importuner l'infirmière de nuit pour un simple verre d'eau.
sentences.en: Thomas doesn't want to bother the night nurse for a mere glass of water.
sentences.ko: 토마는 물 한 잔 때문에 야간 간호사를 귀찮게 하고 싶지 않아요.

sentences.text: Les guêpes de septembre viennent importuner Chloé pendant ses pique-niques.
sentences.en: September wasps come to bother Chloé during her picnics.
sentences.ko: 구월 말벌이 소풍 나온 클로에를 귀찮게 해요.

sentences.text: L'infirmière fixe le tube de Thomas avec un adhésif transparent.
sentences.en: The nurse secures Thomas's tube with clear adhesive tape.
sentences.ko: 간호사가 투명 테이프로 토마의 관을 고정해요.

sentences.text: Avant l'hiver, Chloé colle un adhésif isolant autour des fenêtres.
sentences.en: Before winter, Chloé sticks insulating tape around the windows.
sentences.ko: 겨울이 오기 전에 클로에는 창문 둘레에 단열 테이프를 붙여요.

sentences.text: Thomas travaille son endurance en marchant chaque jour un peu plus loin dans le couloir.
sentences.en: Thomas builds his endurance by walking a little farther down the corridor each day.
sentences.ko: 토마는 매일 복도를 조금씩 더 걸으며 지구력을 길러요.

sentences.text: Chloé prépare son endurance tout l'hiver pour la course du printemps.
sentences.en: Chloé builds up her endurance all winter for the spring race.
sentences.ko: 클로에는 봄 경주를 위해 겨우내 지구력을 길러요.

sentences.text: La kiné propose à Thomas une gymnastique douce dans son lit.
sentences.en: The physiotherapist offers Thomas gentle exercises in his bed.
sentences.ko: 물리치료사가 토마에게 침대에서 하는 가벼운 체조를 권해요.

sentences.text: Quand il pleut trop, Chloé remplace la course par une séance de gymnastique à la maison.
sentences.en: When it rains too much, Chloé replaces running with an exercise session at home.
sentences.ko: 비가 너무 오면 클로에는 달리기 대신 집에서 체조를 해요.

sentences.text: Thomas reste sous perfusion pendant toute la première nuit.
sentences.en: Thomas stays on a drip for the whole first night.
sentences.ko: 토마는 첫날 밤 내내 링거를 맞아요.

sentences.text: Avec la grippe de l'hiver, la grand-mère de Chloé a dû passer une nuit sous perfusion.
sentences.en: With the winter flu, Chloé's grandmother had to spend a night on a drip.
sentences.ko: 겨울 독감 때문에 클로에의 할머니는 하룻밤 링거를 맞아야 했어요.

sentences.text: Pour éviter toute contamination, Thomas porte un masque dans le service.
sentences.en: To avoid any contamination, Thomas wears a mask in the ward.
sentences.ko: 감염을 막으려고 토마는 병동에서 마스크를 써요.

sentences.text: Chaque automne, Chloé lave bien ses mains pour limiter la contamination au bureau.
sentences.en: Every autumn, Chloé washes her hands carefully to limit contamination at the office.
sentences.ko: 가을마다 클로에는 사무실 감염을 줄이려고 손을 꼼꼼히 씻어요.

sentences.text: Le voisin de chambre de Thomas sort d'une cure de désintoxication et se sent fier.
sentences.en: Thomas's roommate is coming out of a rehab program and feels proud.
sentences.ko: 토마와 같은 병실 환자는 해독 치료를 마치고 뿌듯해해요.

sentences.text: Après les fêtes, Chloé fait une cure de désintoxication au chocolat, dit-elle en riant.
sentences.en: After the holidays, Chloé does a chocolate detox, she says laughing.
sentences.ko: 연말이 지나면 클로에는 초콜릿 끊기 기간을 갖는다며 웃어요.

sentences.text: Les infirmiers transportent Thomas sur un brancard jusqu'à la radiologie.
sentences.en: The nurses carry Thomas on a stretcher to radiology.
sentences.ko: 간호사들이 토마를 들것에 실어 영상의학과로 옮겨요.

sentences.text: L'hiver dernier, Chloé a glissé sur le verglas et les secours l'ont emmenée sur un brancard.
sentences.en: Last winter, Chloé slipped on black ice and the emergency services took her away on a stretcher.
sentences.ko: 지난겨울 클로에는 빙판에 미끄러져 구급대원이 들것에 실어 갔어요.

sentences.text: Le chirurgien explique à Thomas que son articulation du genou est très usée.
sentences.en: The surgeon explains to Thomas that his knee joint is very worn.
sentences.ko: 외과 의사가 토마에게 무릎 관절이 많이 닳았다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: Quand l'humidité revient, chaque articulation de Chloé se fait sentir.
sentences.en: When the damp returns, every one of Chloé's joints makes itself felt.
sentences.ko: 습기가 돌아오면 클로에는 관절 마디마디가 쑤셔요.

sentences.text: Thomas passe devant le service de réanimation en allant à la cafétéria.
sentences.en: Thomas walks past the intensive care unit on his way to the cafeteria.
sentences.ko: 토마는 카페테리아에 가다가 중환자실 앞을 지나가요.

sentences.text: Le frère de Chloé travaille en réanimation et connaît bien les pics de grippe de l'hiver.
sentences.en: Chloé's brother works in intensive care and knows the winter flu peaks well.
sentences.ko: 클로에의 오빠는 중환자실에서 일해서 겨울 독감 절정기를 잘 알아요.

sentences.text: Le médecin propose à Thomas un dépistage de la prostate, par précaution.
sentences.en: The doctor offers Thomas a prostate screening as a precaution.
sentences.ko: 의사가 만약을 위해 토마에게 전립선 검사를 권해요.

sentences.text: À l'automne, le père de Chloé participe à une campagne sur le cancer de la prostate.
sentences.en: In autumn, Chloé's father takes part in a prostate cancer campaign.
sentences.ko: 가을에 클로에의 아버지는 전립선암 캠페인에 참여해요.

sentences.text: Sur l'affiche du couloir, Thomas voit les étapes du développement de l'embryon.
sentences.en: On the corridor poster, Thomas sees the stages of embryo development.
sentences.ko: 토마는 복도 포스터에서 배아의 발달 단계를 봐요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, Chloé montre à sa classe un embryon de grenouille dans un aquarium.
sentences.en: In spring, Chloé shows her class a frog embryo in an aquarium.
sentences.ko: 봄이 되면 클로에는 반 아이들에게 수조 속 개구리 배아를 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: La psychiatre explique à Thomas que la psychose se soigne mieux aujourd'hui.
sentences.en: The psychiatrist explains to Thomas that psychosis is better treated today.
sentences.ko: 정신과 의사가 토마에게 요즘은 정신증 치료가 더 잘 된다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: La sœur de Chloé, infirmière, explique qu'une psychose ne dépend pas des saisons.
sentences.en: Chloé's sister, a nurse, explains that a psychosis doesn't depend on the seasons.
sentences.ko: 간호사인 클로에의 언니는 정신증이 계절과는 상관없다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: En sortant, Thomas apporte son ordonnance au pharmacien de l'hôpital.
sentences.en: On his way out, Thomas takes his prescription to the hospital pharmacist.
sentences.ko: 퇴원하면서 토마는 처방전을 병원 약사에게 가져가요.

sentences.text: Dès le printemps, le pharmacien conseille à Chloé un traitement contre le pollen.
sentences.en: As soon as spring comes, the pharmacist recommends a pollen treatment to Chloé.
sentences.ko: 봄이 오자마자 약사가 클로에에게 꽃가루 알레르기 약을 권해요.

sentences.text: Avant l'opération, Thomas fait une prise de sang pour exclure une hépatite.
sentences.en: Before the operation, Thomas has a blood test to rule out hepatitis.
sentences.ko: 수술 전에 토마는 간염이 아닌지 확인하려고 피검사를 해요.

sentences.text: Avant son voyage d'été, Chloé se fait vacciner contre l'hépatite.
sentences.en: Before her summer trip, Chloé gets vaccinated against hepatitis.
sentences.ko: 여름 여행을 앞두고 클로에는 간염 예방 주사를 맞아요.

sentences.text: L'infirmière applique une pommade sur la cicatrice de Thomas.
sentences.en: The nurse applies an ointment to Thomas's scar.
sentences.ko: 간호사가 토마의 흉터에 연고를 발라요.

sentences.text: En hiver, Chloé met de la pommade sur ses lèvres gercées.
sentences.en: In winter, Chloé puts ointment on her chapped lips.
sentences.ko: 겨울이면 클로에는 튼 입술에 연고를 발라요.

sentences.text: Dans l'ascenseur, Thomas croise la pédiatre qui soignait ses enfants.
sentences.en: In the elevator, Thomas runs into the pediatrician who treated his children.
sentences.ko: 엘리베이터에서 토마는 아이들을 진료하던 소아과 의사와 마주쳐요.

sentences.text: Chaque automne, Chloé emmène son fils chez le pédiatre pour le vaccin contre la grippe.
sentences.en: Every autumn, Chloé takes her son to the pediatrician for the flu shot.
sentences.ko: 가을마다 클로에는 아들을 데리고 소아과에 독감 주사를 맞히러 가요.

sentences.text: Thomas est opéré d'une hernie après avoir porté des charges trop lourdes.
sentences.en: Thomas is operated on for a hernia after carrying loads that were too heavy.
sentences.ko: 토마는 너무 무거운 짐을 들다가 탈장이 와서 수술받아요.

sentences.text: En pelletant la neige, le voisin de Chloé s'est fait une hernie.
sentences.en: Shoveling snow, Chloé's neighbor gave himself a hernia.
sentences.ko: 눈을 치우다가 클로에의 이웃은 탈장이 왔어요.

sentences.text: Thomas lit dans une brochure que la tuberculose n'a pas complètement disparu.
sentences.en: Thomas reads in a brochure that tuberculosis hasn't completely disappeared.
sentences.ko: 토마는 안내 책자에서 결핵이 완전히 사라지지 않았다는 걸 읽어요.

sentences.text: Chloé lit qu'autrefois, les malades de la tuberculose passaient l'hiver à la montagne.
sentences.en: Chloé reads that in the past, tuberculosis patients spent the winter in the mountains.
sentences.ko: 클로에는 예전엔 결핵 환자들이 산에서 겨울을 났다는 걸 읽어요.

sentences.text: C'est un secouriste bénévole qui a porté les premiers soins à Thomas après sa chute.
sentences.en: It was a volunteer first-aider who gave Thomas first aid after his fall.
sentences.ko: 토마가 넘어진 뒤 응급처치를 해 준 건 자원봉사 응급 구조원이었어요.

sentences.text: Chloé suit une formation de secouriste au printemps.
sentences.en: Chloé takes a first-aid course in the spring.
sentences.ko: 클로에는 봄에 응급 구조원 교육을 받아요.

sentences.text: Le médecin rassure Thomas : son malaise n'était pas dû à une asphyxie.
sentences.en: The doctor reassures Thomas: his fainting wasn't due to asphyxia.
sentences.ko: 의사가 토마를 안심시켜요. 쓰러진 건 질식 때문이 아니었대요.

sentences.text: En hiver, les pompiers rappellent à Chloé les risques d'asphyxie liés aux vieux poêles.
sentences.en: In winter, the firefighters remind Chloé of the risks of asphyxiation from old stoves.
sentences.ko: 겨울이면 소방관들이 클로에에게 낡은 난로로 인한 질식 위험을 일깨워 줘요.

sentences.text: Pour sa convalescence, le médecin conseille à Thomas la sobriété pendant un mois.
sentences.en: For his recovery, the doctor advises Thomas to stay sober for a month.
sentences.ko: 회복을 위해 의사는 토마에게 한 달 동안 술을 끊으라고 해요.

sentences.text: En janvier, Chloé choisit la sobriété après les excès des fêtes.
sentences.en: In January, Chloé chooses sobriety after the excesses of the holidays.
sentences.ko: 일월이면 클로에는 연말에 과하게 마신 뒤라 술을 멀리해요.

sentences.text: Thomas suce une pastille pour calmer sa gorge sèche après l'intubation.
sentences.en: Thomas sucks a lozenge to soothe his dry throat after the intubation.
sentences.ko: 토마는 삽관 뒤 마른 목을 달래려고 목캔디를 빨아요.

sentences.text: Dès l'automne, Chloé garde des pastilles au miel dans son sac.
sentences.en: From autumn on, Chloé keeps honey lozenges in her bag.
sentences.ko: 가을부터 클로에는 가방에 꿀 목캔디를 넣고 다녀요.

sentences.text: Le neurologue montre à Thomas un schéma de neurone pour expliquer ses fourmillements.
sentences.en: The neurologist shows Thomas a neuron diagram to explain his tingling.
sentences.ko: 신경과 의사가 토마에게 신경 세포 그림을 보여 주며 저림 증상을 설명해요.

sentences.text: Le froid de l'hiver ralentit chaque neurone de Chloé, plaisante-t-elle le matin.
sentences.en: The winter cold slows down every one of Chloé's neurons, she jokes in the morning.
sentences.ko: 겨울 추위에 뇌세포가 하나하나 느려진다고 클로에가 아침마다 농담해요.

sentences.text: Thomas passe une lotion apaisante sur ses mains abîmées par le gel désinfectant.
sentences.en: Thomas applies a soothing lotion to his hands, damaged by the sanitizer gel.
sentences.ko: 토마는 소독젤 때문에 거칠어진 손에 진정 로션을 발라요.

sentences.text: En été, Chloé applique une lotion solaire avant de sortir.
sentences.en: In summer, Chloé applies sun lotion before going out.
sentences.ko: 여름에 클로에는 나가기 전에 자외선 차단 로션을 발라요.

sentences.text: Les analyses de Thomas montrent un taux de globules blancs un peu élevé.
sentences.en: Thomas's tests show a slightly high white blood cell count.
sentences.ko: 토마의 검사 결과 백혈구 수치가 조금 높게 나와요.

sentences.text: Après un hiver fatigant, une prise de sang montre que Chloé manque de globules rouges.
sentences.en: After a tiring winter, a blood test shows Chloé is short of red blood cells.
sentences.ko: 지친 겨울을 보낸 뒤 피검사에서 클로에의 적혈구가 부족하다고 나와요.
